claims.claim: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering as the companies expand work on Muse.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering
claims.source_title: NVIDIA and Meta to Expand Collaboration on Muse and Muse Family of Models Amid Robust Growth
claims.supporting_quote: In addition, NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering.

claims.claim: Meta intends to expand deployment of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X Ethernet and BlueField-4.
claims.episode_span: Meta intends to expand deployment of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems and Vera CPUs
claims.source_title: NVIDIA and Meta to Expand Collaboration on Muse and Muse Family of Models Amid Robust Growth
claims.supporting_quote: Meta intends to expand the deployment of NVIDIA infrastructure, including Vera Rubin and Vera CPUs for next-generation AI agents to deliver maximum performance per watt.

claims.claim: The companies are considering OpenShell for safer agent deployment and Sentry for monitoring.
claims.episode_span: considering Nvidia’s OpenShell Reference Architecture for safer agent deployment and Sentry
claims.source_title: NVIDIA and Meta to Expand Collaboration on Muse and Muse Family of Models Amid Robust Growth
claims.supporting_quote: Meta and NVIDIA will also consider additional collaboration opportunities with NVIDIA on its NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture, including NVIDIA OpenShell™ for safe deployment and NVIDIA Sentry for monitoring agent behavior.

claims.claim: Microsoft's voluntary separation offer covers about 60,000 eligible employees at level 70 and below in Canada, India, the UK and the US.
claims.episode_span: about 60,000 people, roughly a quarter of the workforce
claims.source_title: Microsoft announces a voluntary buyout to 60,000 Employees
claims.supporting_quote: This offer is available to eligible employees on participating teams in Canada, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States at level 70 and below.

claims.claim: Eligible Microsoft employees in India have until December 1 to decide, and Microsoft has about 23,000 employees in India.
claims.source_title: Microsoft Launches Voluntary Exit Offer for 60,000 Staff
claims.supporting_quote: It is learnt that eligible employees in India will have until December 1 to decide on the voluntary exit offer.

claims.claim: Microsoft cited $20.5 billion committed in India from 2025 through 2029 and a goal of equipping 20 million people with AI skills by 2030.
claims.source_title: Microsoft Launches Voluntary Exit Offer for 60,000 Staff
claims.supporting_quote: a Microsoft spokesperson said the company continues to invest in India’s talent and technology ecosystem and is backing the country’s AI ambitions with USD 20.5 billion in committed investment between 2025 and 2029

claims.claim: The new iPad mini is 5.4 mm thin with an 8.5-inch OLED display, 1,200-nit peak brightness and a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio, running the A20 Pro.
claims.episode_span: 5.4 millimetres thin, with an 8.5-inch OLED display
claims.source_title: Apple unveils new iPad Mini with thinner design
claims.supporting_quote: Apple’s new iPad mini comes with a larger 8.5-inch OLED display, and is 5.4mm thin

claims.claim: iPad mini pre-orders start October 28 and availability begins November 6; India Wi-Fi pricing starts at ₹82,900.
claims.episode_span: Pre-orders open October 28 and sales begin November 6
claims.source_title: Apple unveils new iPad Mini with thinner design
claims.supporting_quote: Customers can pre-order the new iPad mini and the new Smart Folio from October 28, with availability beginning November 6.

claims.claim: The US starting price of the new iPad mini is $699, and IOL reported CPU gains up to 60 percent and GPU speed about 2.7 times the predecessor.
claims.source_title: Apple unveils redesigned, thinner iPad mini with OLED display
claims.supporting_quote: That price is $699 in the US, which converts directly to R11,619.

claims.claim: iOS 27.2 addresses more than 160 security vulnerabilities, none actively exploited, and adds Siri AI conversation recall.
claims.source_title: iOS 27.2 Features: Everything New in iOS 27.2
claims.supporting_quote: iOS 27.2 addresses more than 160 security vulnerabilities.

claims.claim: Meta plans to sell up to $97.5 billion in stock, starting with $37.5 billion of Class A and depositary shares, with up to $60 billion of Class C from Q1 2027.
claims.episode_span: sell up to $97.5 billion in stock
claims.source_title: Meta announces plans to sell up to USD 95 billion in new shares to fund AI plans
claims.supporting_quote: The plan starts with the sale of USD 37.5 billion worth of its Class A stock and new depositary shares based on preferred stock.

claims.claim: The Times of India reported silicon suppliers eyeing a $5 billion stake amid circular-capital concerns, with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom interested.
claims.episode_span: silicon suppliers are eyeing a $5 billion stake
claims.source_title: Meta plans to raise up to $95 billion for its AI expansion through two stock offerings
claims.supporting_quote: Silicon suppliers eye $5 billion stake amid ‘Circular Capital’ concerns

claims.claim: The Information said Monday's fundraising plans from Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta could collectively add up to almost a quarter of a trillion dollars.
claims.episode_span: Almost a quarter of a trillion dollars is the sum The Information put on three fundraising plans
claims.source_title: Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Cash Grabs
claims.supporting_quote: On Monday, Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Platforms all unveiled their respective plans for raising gobs of cash to fund their AI ambitions, which could collectively add up to almost a quarter of a trillion dollars

claims.claim: SpaceX agreed a $40 billion GPU financing with an Apollo-managed entity, described as the largest GPU financing in history, expected via an off-balance-sheet SPV.
claims.episode_span: SpaceX signed a $40 billion financing agreement
claims.source_title: Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Cash Grabs
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX’s $40 billion financing agreement with an entity managed by Apollo Global Management, through which the company will lease graphics processing units for its data centers.

claims.claim: Microsoft's global workforce is 223,000; an earlier buyout went to 9,000 people of whom about a third accepted, and fewer than 20,000 are expected to take the new offer.
claims.source_title: Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Cash Grabs
claims.supporting_quote: 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce of 223,000, will be eligible for the offer.
